newsitem.title: USA: Independence Bancorp says to merge.
newsitem.headline: Independence Bancorp says to merge.

text.p: Independence Bancorp Inc said Monday it has reached an agreement to be acquired by Commerce Bancorp Inc in a stock swap.
Under the deal, 0.935 shares of Commerce Bancorp common stock is to be exchanged for each share of Independence common stock at about $25 per exchanged Independence share, the company said.
The transaction is subject to a definitive agreement, as well as approval by shareholders and various regulatory authorities.
Independence did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information.
Commerce Bancorp is based in Cherry Hill, N.J.
